fluff.overview: The Troika is a sixty-five-ton medium aerospace fighter developed through the industrial cooperation of the Trinity Alliance, the political and military pact linking the Taurian Concordat, the Magistracy of Canopus, and the Capellan Confederation. Brought into existence at the Detroit Consolidated AeroSpace facility on Detroit during the early 3060s, it stands as a genuine technological achievement for the Periphery states, a modern fighter incorporating the latest Inner Sphere advances in propulsion, protection, and weapons systems. The Trinity Alliance designed the Troika to serve as a capable all-aspect fighter for forces that had long relied on aging Succession Wars-era designs, and the result met that requirement. Though contractual obligations initially directed production toward the Concordat, the bulk of the fighter's service has been with the Magistracy of Canopus and later the Capellan Confederation, which ultimately absorbed responsibility for its ongoing development and production.
fluff.capabilities:
The Troika's airframe uses a Magna 260 XL engine to achieve safe thrust 6 and maximum thrust 9, placing it near the upper end of the medium fighter performance bracket. Detroit Ferro-Aluminum Special armor provides solid protection across the hull, and cellular ammunition storage equipment shields the pilot from munitions detonation. The fighter's primary long-range punch comes from its nose-mounted Tomodzuru LRM-20, which accepts Thunder submunitions for area-denial and indirect fire roles. Each wing carries an extended-range PPC paired with an extended-range medium laser, providing heavy energy strike capability across multiple range bands.

Seventeen double heat sinks provide adequate but not generous thermal management. Pilots running the full energy suite simultaneously generate significant heat, and experienced crews throttle their weapons during sustained engagements rather than firing everything at once. The ferro-aluminum armor is lighter than conventional plating, freeing mass for the weapons payload while maintaining effective protection. Overall, the Troika balances energy and missile firepower well for its class, though its heat performance demands disciplined trigger management under sustained combat conditions.
fluff.deployment: The CMT-7T is a Dark Age redesign of the Troika developed under Capellan Confederation management of the Detroit facility. The variant replaces the extended-range PPCs, wing medium lasers, and four double heat sinks with a Beagle active probe in the nose, large re-engineered lasers in each wing alongside the retained LRM-20, and a rear-mounted medium re-engineered laser for aft defense. This loadout emphasizes reconnaissance capability and hard-hitting direct-fire accuracy over the base model's mixed energy-and-missile profile, while the aft laser provides protection against pursuit. Introduced in the 3130s and active through the ilClan period, the CMT-7T serves exclusively in Capellan Confederation aerospace forces and represents the most modern production variant of the Troika family.
fluff.history:
The Troika's development began as a direct outgrowth of Trinity Alliance politics in the early 3060s. When the Taurian Concordat provided military assistance to bring the Capellan Confederation into the Alliance, including support for the conquest of the St. Ives Compact, Concordat President Shraplen negotiated improved technology access in return. Capellan scientists, technicians, and educators moved to Taurian and Magistracy worlds, while negotiations opened for upgrading an aerospace production facility already under construction on Detroit. This arrangement gave both the Concordat and the Magistracy of Canopus a path to advanced aerospace technology. The Capellans contributed engineering expertise while the Magistracy provided manpower and covered nearly the entire cost of the facility, creating what became Detroit Consolidated AeroSpace.

Development proceeded alongside the troubled Anubis BattleMech program at the same facility. When field tests showed the Anubis to be poorly designed, confidence in the Detroit operation suffered, but the Troika project continued separately. In 3065 the new fighter flew its first mission. Under the Trinity Alliance production agreement, the first two runs went to the Taurian Concordat, with subsequent output flowing primarily to the Magistracy of Canopus; particularly the Second Velites Air Division and the Twenty-first Corps Air Division. The Concordat High Command pressed for additional allocations, but nearly all production was already committed to Magistracy and Confederation orders.

The Jihad disrupted Trinity Alliance coordination but did not destroy the Detroit facility. As the post-Jihad era settled into the Republic period, management of the facility and its successor programs transitioned toward the Capellan Confederation, reflecting broader political realignments across former Alliance territory. Capellan engineers introduced updated variants through the Dark Age period, extending the Troika's service life well beyond its original design expectations and inspiring later fighter development within the Confederation. During the Jihad, the Capellan pilot and technician Viktor Janko assembled a personal custom version of the fighter using salvaged Clan weaponry, earning a Hero of the Confederation designation from the Chancellor before declining the accompanying noble title.
